enchdesc.activate.message: Hold %s to see what the enchantments do
enchdesc.config.require_shift.tooltip: Show the descriptions only while Shift is held, with a hint line otherwise.
enchdesc.config.only_on_books.tooltip: Describe the enchantments of enchanted books, not those on tools and armour.
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc: Mine at normal speed while under water.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: More damage to spiders, bees, silverfish, endermites and other arthropods, and slows them.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Once worn, this item cannot be taken off until it breaks or you die.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Less damage from explosions and less knockback from them.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Hits pierce part of the target's armour.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: A thrown trident calls lightning on the mob it hits during a thunderstorm.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Smash attacks deal more damage for each block fallen.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Less damage from fire and lava, and burning ends sooner.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Arrows set what they hit on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Water under your feet freezes into ice you can walk on.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: More damage to mobs in water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Shooting uses no normal arrows, as long as you carry one.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: A thrown trident comes back to you.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Better chances of treasure when fishing.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: Attacking with the spear dashes you forward.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Experience you collect repairs this item.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: Shoots three arrows for the price of one.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc: Arrows pass through several mobs and through shields.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Less damage from arrows and other projectiles.
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc: Arrows knock the target back further.
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc: Hold your breath longer under water and see better there.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: In water or rain, throwing the trident launches you with it.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Mined blocks drop themselves instead of their usual drops.
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc: More damage to undead mobs such as zombies and skeletons.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: Sweeping attacks deal more damage to the mobs around the target.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Attackers take damage when they hit you.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: This item wears out more slowly.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: This item disappears when you die.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: A smash attack launches you back up into the air.
